title: What's New in v2.9.73
notes: 🛡️ Real-Time Token Health & Expiry Badges: Sync badges update dynamically based on live token scan telemetry, JWT crypto expiry dates, and real-time Firebase listeners.
🔔 Automated Notification Bell Token Alerts: Notification bell alerts trigger automatically when 30-day tokens are expiring soon (<= 3 days) or expired with 1-click in-game renewal actions.
⚡ Instant Multi-Maintenance Sync: BDC Central Command v1.0.73 continuously syncs member tokens, furnace upgrades, and avatars directly to Firebase and Google Sheets.
